run_Trainer: run the submitit Trainer to train a multi-hop dense retriever model on a cluster
checkpoint_TrainerState: save and load a TrainerState checkpoint to resume multi-hop retriever training from a saved state
eval_Trainer: evaluate the trained multi-hop retriever model and compute MRR-1 and MRR-2 scores on test data
log_Trainer: log training metrics like MRR and loss to a JSON log file during multi-hop retriever training
setup_Trainer: initialize the Trainer with training config and cluster config to set up distributed training with submitit
